about: Verified roster status of players in the Recruit Development Forecast (2025 class), kept under version control because the dashboard data file is hand-maintained in the deployment settings. Same format as the data file's watchClassStatus; the later verification date wins. A status never changes a forecast: it only moves the original prediction to the matching group. Add an entry only with a verification date and a source.

Chaz Coleman.source: Not on Penn State's 2026 roster (CFBD roster data, pulled by 2026-10-14). Entered the transfer portal in January 2026 and committed to Tennessee (CBS Sports, 2026-01-10). Medically disqualified and removed from Tennessee's roster (CBS Sports, 2026-06-26; 247Sports).
